answer: A concrete Sybil defense in an agent economy is a non-transferable bond required before any identity may submit work. Each new agent address must lock collateral frozen while its reputation is young, and reputation binds to that address, so it cannot be copied to a fresh key. An attacker spawning many personas pays the bond in full for each one, linearly, with no discount. If a bond is slashed for faked results, they lose the stake they must keep topping up. The fable of free identities becomes a real bill, and the timber of that bill scales with the tide of fakes; honest work is cheapest.
